sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: No way! I refuse to accept that!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I don't understand. Accept it or not, I am Ken Takakura.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Stop it! I don't wanna hear it!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Crap! The curse! Miss Ayase! Hurry! Your psychic powers!

sp.speaker: Turbo Granny
sp.p: Lemme gobble that weenie!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Th-Thank you very much.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Let's set a few rules. No speaking your name.

sp.speaker: ken
sp.p: Okay

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Because you like the occult, you're Ken

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: O-Okarun?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: If you use that name, I'll kill you.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: "That name"? It's my own name. Well, I guess I have mo choice, so that's fine.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You don't seem that upset about it, Okarun!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What? This is against my will!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hey, lemme see your face! You're looking happy, Okarun!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You farted in front of my face! You're the worst

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: It's because you're putting pressure on me, Miss Ayase!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hold on a sec! It's already morning! That means Turbo Granny won't come out anymore?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Huh? Is that true.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I mean, ghosts show up at night, right? Why don't you come to my place for now? That outfit... is scarier than a ghost.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: My Grandma's really hard on guys so be careful. She almost killed a previous boyfriend,

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Huh? You wait till now to say that?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What's going on Ken! Are you okay?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Must be this. Sorry, Ken! A barrier's been put up!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I thought I was gonna die.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Okay, now try coming in!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Is it really gonna be okay?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: If you burn, I'll toss you into the river again, so it's okay.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Whoa, Freaky.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You're safe! How do you feel? Any changes?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: My entire body tingles.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: More like, what's with your head? Totally hilarious! It's a granny perm!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Freaky! What are you laughing about? I was about to die there!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Grandma! Huh? Grandma's not here. Oh well. Come on up.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: E-Excuse me.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hold on a minute. I'll change clothes, so close the door.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Oh, okay. Miss Ayase! The curse!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hey! Don't just open the door! Face the wall!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I-I'm sorry.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Sheesh, what a pain. Ken, put these on. It's ladieswear but it should be okay.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Sorry to trouble you.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: By the way, you don't have anything down there, do you?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What? What do you mean? I'm sorry! I ddin't look!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: It's fine now.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hey, hey. Show me what's down there. Turbo Granny was saying that you're cursed because your weenie has been taken.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: It's gone!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What? No way! What's it look like? Show me!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I can't show you! Are you stupid?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: But there's nothing there, right?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: The issue isn't whether or not it's there!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Man, you're so cheap.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: This is the worst! What are we gonna do about this? It's not there!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Don't make it sound like I'm the villian.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: You're the one who challenged me!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Huh? I wasn't interested in your occult stories to begin with!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I only picked a fight because you kept talking to me! I didn't want to miss my chance. I've always wanted a friend. So I thought, I didn't want to miss this chnace.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: But in the end... You live in a different world, Miss Ayase. You're not someone that a person like me should be talking to. I'm so sorry... that I roped you into so much danger. When this is all over you can just ignore me again.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: That's the annoying part about you.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You asume how others feel and jump to conclusions without asking. The reason you don't have friends is because you shove them away.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: don't say that I can ignore you. We can just talk about the occult like normal

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Hey, say something. Poke, poke.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: You're so ugly!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Huh? What did you just say, punk?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: You are completely tactless, Miss Ayase! You bluntly recite people's weaknesses!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What the hell is tact?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Perhaps yours grandmother is back?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: shh! Stay quiet. I've never heard a doorball like this.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What do you mean?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Grandma told me in the past... that we have two doorbells. One is for humans, and the other is for... evil spirits

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Crap! It's becasue I took that talisman off!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: It's okay if it's for a little bit, right?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Oh, no!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: There's something out there! What are we gonna do?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I'll put the tailsman back up! f it's an evil spirit, It'll burn up like you did, right?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Are you going to burn me, too?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You can just get outside of our plot!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Please wait to put up the tailsman until I step outside!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: It's gone. Where did it go?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Miss Ayase! Look at this!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Crap! Crap! We gotta leave the plot now! Go that way! Hurry!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: -Miss Ayase!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: -What?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: We can't get out. We're trapped inside by a wall.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: The torii gate! I can attach the talisman!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Please wait! You can't put the talisman up!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Why not?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: The torii gate is embedded into the wall!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: We can't leave the plot like this!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What should we do?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: If we don't do anything, we're seriously...

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What is this?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: We're in serious trouble!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Miss Ayase! Help... me...

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Okarun, are you okay? Get a grip on yourself!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Black fog. S it's because of that.

sp.speaker: Alien
sp.p: Found... you...

sp.speaker: Alien
sp.p: You are evil people. You broke the promise. Give me… your banana!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Crap! What's with that evil spirit? Wait, you have another one down there?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Of course not! That's an alien

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Huh?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: There's no doubt about it! That collar! That's a Flatwoods Monster! They were first witnessed in a town in America called Flatwoods. In Japan, they've been sighted in Yamanashi. They're known as "aliens who are three meters tall."

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Then what was that doorbell?
You're saying a chime specifically for ghosts reacted to an alien?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: There are studies that say people who see spiritual phenomena often see UFOs as well! In other words, there might be something in common between ghosts and aliens!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: In other words, there might be something in common between ghosts and aliens! If we don't hurry up and do something about that thing, the poison fog will k*ll us But if I'm holding Okarun's curse back, I can't use my psychic powers well.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Miss Ayase.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Sheesh, what a pain!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Huh?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Sheesh!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Miss Ayase.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What is it now?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I will fight. Please release the curse!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What's this so suddenly?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I'm not afraid of aliens! Can you release just the physical curse while keeping my head in check?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You make it sound easy, but I haven't learned how to control this power!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: If all goes well, we might be able to control that Granny's powers!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I'm not sure if I can do it right!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Please try! -Miss Ayase! Here it comes!

sp.speaker: Alien
sp.p: -Give it to me!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Please hurry!
This is amazing.
I'm brimming with power!
But I'm totally depressed.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Whoa! Is his psyche broken?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
My conscious is clear, yo...
But I totally have the blues, yo...

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What's with that manner of speech?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Oh, sorry
I am an awkward fellow after all, yo...

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I told you not to say that!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
I should just, yo...
Eradicate myself, yo?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Stop talking like that! It pisses me off!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I'll be back in a little bit. I'm sure it won't work, yo...

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Hey!
Look ahead! In front of you!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
My body moved outta reflex.
So this is Turbo Granny's powers?
I feel so dejected.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
So fast. When'd he learn to do that?
Wait, what's going on?
Okarun!

sp.speaker: Alien
sp.p: Give it to me!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Crap!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
I'm sorry, Miss Ayase! My body can't keep up with the power of the curse!
My entire body feels like it's going to burst into a million pieces!
This isn't a speed that humans can move in!
But I've only damaged five fingers from that thing!
How the hell are we gonna defeat something like that?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: Like I know! Don't get pissed at me!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
If we knew how to defeat it, we wouldn't be struggling!
That thing…
Is it sumo wrestling?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Come again?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: If we can get its hand to touch the ground, maybe we win?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Miss Ayase, are you a genius?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I knew I was.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Next time is my limit, okay?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Okarun, aim for the legs.
I'll make the thing trip with my psychic powers!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Man, I'm so depressed.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: We have to get a bit closer, so you have to back me up!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What a pain.

sp.speaker: Alien
sp.p: Give me your banana!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: I can't take it anymore!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Hold back the curse with my right hand,
and I'll take on this guy with my left hand!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: What a pain!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Oh, hold on.
Sorry, Okarun!
All right! The hand is melting!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Just like how we planned!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You're kidding.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Miss Ayase, run for it!
Miss Ayase!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Crap. This is bad news.
I'm back.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Sheesh. You really are a nuisance.
Hey, sumo alien!
You put your hand on the ground.
That's cheating, you scumbag.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Miss Ayase!
Please release the curse one more time!
I don't care what happens to my body!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
I'm gonna beat the crap outta this thing!
You sit and watch, Okarun!
I can't let cheaters off the hook!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Wait, what are you saying?

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: You really pissed me off, wimpy alien.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Stop it!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: That did nothing!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Please release my curse, Miss Ayase! I'm begging you! If this keeps up, you'll die!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
This is fine.
This depth is great.
Because if I'm in this deep…
it means I'm outside of the torii gate!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
We're back.
We're saved.
Okarun! We're back! See?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Oh, yes.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: I really thought I was gonna die!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Oh! Miss Ayase, the curse!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Come on! Don't be a pain!
At least let me indulge in the moment!

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: You say that, but I can't do anything about this.

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: What? You change your hairdo?

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: Of course not!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p: That kinda looks good. I did prefer the granny perm, though.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p: But you made fun of it!

sp.speaker: Momo
sp.p:
Huh? I'm kinda dizzy.
Oh, crap.

sp.speaker: Ken
sp.p:
Huh?
Miss Ayase?
Get a hold of yourself! Miss Ayase!
